feeds.title: University of Warwick News
feeds.description: Warwick Law School pioneered the study of law in its social, political and economic context. The School research follows many tracks, emphasizing historical, international, comparative, theoretical and cross cultural approaches. Its contextual approach encompasses criminal, commercial, corporate, environmental and human rights law.
